questions.question: Rahul is 6 years younger than his elder brother Shyam. Rahul also has a sister who is 4 years younger to him. What is the difference between the age of Rahul and the average age of the three siblings?
questions.solution:
Let, Rahul's age = x

∴ Rahul's brothers age = x + 6

∴ Rahul's sister's age = x - 4

∴ Their total age = (x + x + 6 + x - 4) = 3x + 2

∴ Their average age = (3x + 2)/3 = x + 2/3

Required difference,

⇒ (x + 2/3) - x

⇒ 2/3 year = 8 months

questions.question: Reshma bought a showpiece for Rs. 731 with a discount of 14% on the marked price. Find the marked price of the showpiece.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 731

Discount = 14%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP – Discount

Where, SP = Selling Price

CP = Cost Price

**Calculation:**

Let Marked price (MP) of showpiece be Rs. x

According to the question:

⇒ Discount = 14% of x = Rs. 0.14x

Now,

SP = MP – Discount

⇒ SP = x – 0.14x

⇒ 731 = 0.86x

⇒ x = 731/0.86 = 850

**∴ Marked Price of showpiece is Rs. 850.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

Let, marked price = x

According to problem,

⇒ x - x × 14/100 = 731

⇒ 0.86x = 731

⇒ x = 850

∴ Marked Price of showpiece is Rs. 850.

questions.question: A vendor offers a 24% discount on a computer table with a marked price of Rs. 7600. If he still earns a profit of Rs. 400, what is the cost price of the table?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of the table = Rs. x

According to problem,

⇒ x + 400 = 7600 - 7600 × 24/100

⇒ x + 400 = 5776

⇒ x = 5376

∴ Cost price of the table = Rs. 5376

questions.question: A cloth seller sells 40% of his particular item and recovers the cost price. What will be his profit percentage after selling the complete stock, if he continues to sell rest of his stock at the same price?
questions.solution:
Let, total item = X

Let, cost price of each item = Rs. a

And selling price of each item = Rs. b

According to the problem,

⇒ X × (40/100) × b = X × a

⇒ b = 2.5a

∴ Profit percentage,

⇒ ((2.5a - a )/a) × 100%

⇒ 150%

**Calculation:**

 Rightarrow frac{{3x + 6000}}{{4x + 6000}} = (4)/(5)

⇒ 16x + 24000 = 15x + 30000

⇒ x = 6000

new monthly salary of A ,

 Rightarrow frac{{1.05x - x}}{x} times 100

questions.question: A fruit vendor buys a dozen coconut for Rs. 360. What should be per pair price so that he can earn 30 percent profit?
questions.solution:
Price of 12 coconuts = Rs. 360

∴ Price of 2 coconuts = Rs. (360 × 2/12) = Rs. 60

∴ Selling price of per pair coconut at 30% profit,

⇒ Rs. (60 + 60 × 30/100)

questions.question: X can do a piece of work in 15 hours. He works at it for 5 hours and then Y finishes the work in 5 hours. How long will they together take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
X can do a work in = 15 hours

∴ In 1 hour X can do = 1/15

∴ In 5 hours X can do = 5/15 = 1/3

∴Remaining work = 1 – 1/3 = 2/3

In 5 hours y can do = 2/3

∴In 1 hour Y can do = 2/15

Let, they together complete the work in = a hour

According to the problem,

 Rightarrow a( {(1)/({15)} + (2)/({15)}} ) = 1

 Rightarrow a( {frac{{1 + 2}}{{15}}} ) = 1

 Rightarrow a ( {(3)/({15)}} ) = 1

 Rightarrow a = frac{{15}}{3}

 Rightarrow a = 5

∴ They together complete the work in 5 hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Let the total work be the 15 units

Efficiency of X = 15/15 = 1 unit/day

X work for 5 hours and completed work = 1 × 5 = 5 units

Remaining = 15 - 5 = 10 units

Y finishes the remaining work with efficiency = 10/5 = 2 units/day

∴ Together can complete the work in time = 15/(2 + 1) = 5 hours

questions.question: How many whole numbers are there between 244 and 332 which are exactly divisible by 7?
questions.solution:
Numbers that are divisible by 7 between 244 and 332,

⇒ 245, 252.........329

Using AP:

aₙ = a + (n - 1)d

329 = 245 + (n - 1) × 7

n = 13

∴ There are 13 numbers

questions.question: If Rs. 3162 is divided in the ratio of 3 : 7 : 11 : 13 among A, B, C and D respectively, what will be the share of D?
questions.solution:
Ratio of A, B, C and D = 3 : 7 : 11 : 13

Let, share of A = Rs. 3x

Share of B = Rs. 7x

Share of C = Rs. 11x

Share of D = Rs. 13x

According to problem,

⇒ 3x + 7x + 11x + 13x = 3162

⇒ 34x = 3162

⇒ x = 93

∴ Share of D = 13 × 93 = Rs. 1209

questions.question: What is the amount of fund collected through Consultancy Projects and Research Activities together?
